door_act2.png.prompt:
The attached reference image is a room from this game - match its art style, colour temperature, material feel, brush work and line weight exactly, so this door looks like it belongs in that room.

Draw ONLY A CLOSED DOUBLE DOOR, seen straight on from the front, filling the picture: a grand WOODEN Japanese gateway in dark timber. Two matching leaves that meet in the middle.

IMPORTANT - it must have a DISTINCT SILHOUETTE, not a plain rectangle:
- a wide overhanging TILED ROOF across the top with upswept curved eaves that stick out past the door on both sides, ridge tiles along the crest
- thick round timber posts framing each side, standing on low stone bases that flare outward at the bottom
- the top corners of the whole structure should be irregular and interesting against the empty background, NOT a flat straight edge

The doors themselves: upper half fitted with pale paper panels in a lattice grid (warm light glowing faintly behind them), lower half solid vertical planks with iron corner brackets, a black iron pull ring on each leaf, one paper charm slip pasted on each leaf near the seam.

HARD RULES - the game splits this image down the exact middle and slides the two halves apart, so:
- the whole thing MUST be perfectly SYMMETRICAL left-to-right, and the seam where the two leaves meet MUST be exactly at the horizontal centre of the picture, running straight from top to bottom
- the door must be CLOSED, with no gap between the leaves
- nothing may cross the centre seam (no chain, no banner, no rope, no single charm spanning both leaves)
- draw ONLY the gateway structure. NO floor, NO wall beyond the posts, NO characters, no text, no letters, no watermark

Cute cartoon storybook style, thick black outlines, flat colours with soft shading, not photorealistic.
Draw everything SOLID and OPAQUE - flat filled colour. Nothing transparent or see-through.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying. Nothing green on the gateway.
Output 768x1024 PNG. Save the image as door_act2.png in the current directory and report the path.
